title: Category icons flip to black on light colors
summary: Every category icon is drawn in white, which disappears on a light category color -- icons now check the category's own color and invert to black automatically when it's light enough that white wouldn't be visible.
The all-day event dot (used in the month view and previews) always sits on a near-white badge regardless of category color, so its icon is now always forced dark instead of only sometimes.
